tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Laptops for distribution to the SC/ST Category Students of UAS, Dharwad.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Estate Office, Krishi nagar, UAS, Dharwad

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Terms & Condition as per the Tender Document Annexed

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: List of similar work / supply undertaken for various Government / Quasi Government Organizations /Autonomous Institutions/ Universities during the last 3 financial years in Section- XII of the K/G-III documents alongwith the supply orders / work orders of preceding 3 years that is 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

Satisfactory completion Certificate: For having supplied Laptops / similar equipment to Central Govt. / State Govt. / Semi Govt. / Public sector undertaking / Universities in accordance with the Section VII of the tender documents - for preceding 3 years(2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Satisfactory Completion Certificate for preceding 3 years(2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the bidder is a authorized representative of a manufacturer, authorization letter issued by the original equipment manufacturers with tender number, in the prescribed format. (Section XIII of standard tender documents).
PAN Card issued by I.T Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PAN Card issued by I.T Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: IT Returns : The tenderer should have submitted IT returns for the Last 3 years i.e. 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- IT Returns : The tenderer should have submitted IT returns for the  Last 3 years  i.e. 2023-24 , 2024-25  & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Annual Turnover Certificate: Shall enclose Annual Turnover Certificates of preceding 3 years issued from Chartered Accountant i.e. for the last 3 years - 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26. The supplier should have an average annual turnover as per the rules.
Declaration for abiding terms and conditions of tender and also declaration for abiding terms and conditions laid under the Goods Manual under standards tender documents- K/G-III.
The agencies shall submit the signed documents of all sections of K/G-III standard tender documents uploaded by the purchaser in e-procurement portal.

The tenderer should furnish details of service centres and information on service support facilities that would be provided after the warranty period (in the service support form given in section XV).

Participating firms have to give information about specifications of the Laptops to be supplied Section VI of standard tender documents including warranty period alongwith Product Brand/Make, brochures, illustrative leaflets, Catalogues, etc giving technical particulars / detailed specifications, warranty, etc., Also they should compulsorily upload a separate statement of compliance comparing the configuration/specifications as stated in the tender document. Deviations if any along with explanation shall be clearly mentioned

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Specification, catalogue, Brochure and Compliance

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Valid Address, Adhar Card/Voter ID/Passport / Driving Licence. Valid Email. ID, Valid Contact No. All correspondence will be made to the contact details provided. If any change in contact details shall be informed to this office
Vendors shall mention the period required for supply of Laptops under the tender notification in their technical bid.
